content.Title: What should I do if my X10 Pro Omni T2351 reports a warning 7031:Return failed, please clear the area around the station, Failed to return to the base station?
content.Content:
* 1.The robot is blocked by obstacles during the process of getting on the seat, so it cannot enter the station. Please check and clear the obstacles around the station to ensure that there is enough space around the station.

https://d3pkbgk01oouhl.cloudfront.net/upload_file/prod/Ensure-adequate-space-around-the-base-station.png

* 2.It is recommended not to place the station on the carpet. The robot is more likely to slip or be blocked when it moves backwards on the carpet.
* 3.Please check whether the robot's swivel wheel is seriously entangled with hair. This may make it difficult for the robot to get onto the station. Please clean the hair on the swivel wheel and try again.
https://d3pkbgk01oouhl.cloudfront.net/upload_file/prod/Check-robot-swivel-wheel-for-heavy-hair-entanglement.png
https://d3pkbgk01oouhl.cloudfront.net/upload_file/prod/How-to-clean-robot-swivel-wheel.mov

4. Check the surface and grooves of the robot's left and right wheels for sand, gravel, or oil stains. If there are, wipe them clean with a dry or slightly damp cloth. After cleaning, manually return the robot to the base station.

content.Title: what should I do when T2080 S1 Pro has EB1L: The robot encountered an error while adding clean water. Task ended/Robot injecting clean water abnormally?
content.Content:
1. Remove the clean water tank from the base station and check the seal ring of the outlet hole to ensure that it is installed correctly. Have the user shine a flashlight on the clean water tank pipe to check whether the pipe inside the clean water tank is damaged.

https://d3pkbgk01oouhl.cloudfront.net/upload_file/prod/the-silicone-rubber-sealing-ring-for-clean-water-outlet.png

https://d3pkbgk01oouhl.cloudfront.net/upload_file/prod/check-the-pipe-of-clean-water-tank.png

2. Fill the water tank with clean water to the maximum water level, then ensure the water tank is securely placed in the base station.

3. Check the robot's water inlet for debris or blockages, then clean with a paper towel or cotton swab.

https://d3pkbgk01oouhl.cloudfront.net/upload_file/prod/water-filling-interface.png

4. After the error occurs, remove the robot from the base station and check the rubber plug at the base station's water inlet to see if there is any water. Additionally, check if the rubber plug is damaged or missing.

https://d3pkbgk01oouhl.cloudfront.net/upload_file/prod/Silicone-for-base-station-water-injection2.png

5. Update the firmware to version 7.0.143 or higher.

content.Title: what should I do when T2080 S1 Pro has EB1L: The robot encountered an error while adding clean water. Task ended/Robot injecting clean water abnormally?
content.Content:
1. Remove the clean water tank from the base station and check the seal ring of the outlet hole to ensure that it is installed correctly. Have the user shine a flashlight on the clean water tank pipe to check whether the pipe inside the clean water tank is damaged.

https://d3pkbgk01oouhl.cloudfront.net/upload_file/prod/the-silicone-rubber-sealing-ring-for-clean-water-outlet.png

https://d3pkbgk01oouhl.cloudfront.net/upload_file/prod/check-the-pipe-of-clean-water-tank.png

2. Fill the water tank with clean water to the maximum water level, then ensure the water tank is securely placed in the base station.

3. Check the robot's water inlet for debris or blockages, then clean with a paper towel or cotton swab.

https://d3pkbgk01oouhl.cloudfront.net/upload_file/prod/water-filling-interface.png

4. After the error occurs, remove the robot from the base station and check the rubber plug at the base station's water inlet to see if there is any water. Additionally, check if the rubber plug is damaged or missing.

https://d3pkbgk01oouhl.cloudfront.net/upload_file/prod/Silicone-for-base-station-water-injection2.png

5. Update the firmware to version 7.0.143 or higher.

content.Title: What should I do if my X10 Pro Omni T2351 reports a warning 7031:Return failed, please clear the area around the station, Failed to return to the base station?
content.Content:
* 1.The robot is blocked by obstacles during the process of getting on the seat, so it cannot enter the station. Please check and clear the obstacles around the station to ensure that there is enough space around the station.

https://d3pkbgk01oouhl.cloudfront.net/upload_file/prod/Ensure-adequate-space-around-the-base-station.png

* 2.It is recommended not to place the station on the carpet. The robot is more likely to slip or be blocked when it moves backwards on the carpet.
* 3.Please check whether the robot's swivel wheel is seriously entangled with hair. This may make it difficult for the robot to get onto the station. Please clean the hair on the swivel wheel and try again.
https://d3pkbgk01oouhl.cloudfront.net/upload_file/prod/Check-robot-swivel-wheel-for-heavy-hair-entanglement.png
https://d3pkbgk01oouhl.cloudfront.net/upload_file/prod/How-to-clean-robot-swivel-wheel.mov

4. Check the surface and grooves of the robot's left and right wheels for sand, gravel, or oil stains. If there are, wipe them clean with a dry or slightly damp cloth. After cleaning, manually return the robot to the base station.

content.Title: what should I do when T2080 S1 Pro has EB1L: The robot encountered an error while adding clean water. Task ended/Robot injecting clean water abnormally?
content.Content:
1. Remove the clean water tank from the base station and check the seal ring of the outlet hole to ensure that it is installed correctly. Have the user shine a flashlight on the clean water tank pipe to check whether the pipe inside the clean water tank is damaged.

https://d3pkbgk01oouhl.cloudfront.net/upload_file/prod/the-silicone-rubber-sealing-ring-for-clean-water-outlet.png

https://d3pkbgk01oouhl.cloudfront.net/upload_file/prod/check-the-pipe-of-clean-water-tank.png

2. Fill the water tank with clean water to the maximum water level, then ensure the water tank is securely placed in the base station.

3. Check the robot's water inlet for debris or blockages, then clean with a paper towel or cotton swab.

https://d3pkbgk01oouhl.cloudfront.net/upload_file/prod/water-filling-interface.png

4. After the error occurs, remove the robot from the base station and check the rubber plug at the base station's water inlet to see if there is any water. Additionally, check if the rubber plug is damaged or missing.

https://d3pkbgk01oouhl.cloudfront.net/upload_file/prod/Silicone-for-base-station-water-injection2.png

5. Update the firmware to version 7.0.143 or higher.

content.Title: what should I do when T2080 S1 Pro has EB1L: The robot encountered an error while adding clean water. Task ended/Robot injecting clean water abnormally?
content.Content:
1. Remove the clean water tank from the base station and check the seal ring of the outlet hole to ensure that it is installed correctly. Have the user shine a flashlight on the clean water tank pipe to check whether the pipe inside the clean water tank is damaged.

https://d3pkbgk01oouhl.cloudfront.net/upload_file/prod/the-silicone-rubber-sealing-ring-for-clean-water-outlet.png

https://d3pkbgk01oouhl.cloudfront.net/upload_file/prod/check-the-pipe-of-clean-water-tank.png

2. Fill the water tank with clean water to the maximum water level, then ensure the water tank is securely placed in the base station.

3. Check the robot's water inlet for debris or blockages, then clean with a paper towel or cotton swab.

https://d3pkbgk01oouhl.cloudfront.net/upload_file/prod/water-filling-interface.png

4. After the error occurs, remove the robot from the base station and check the rubber plug at the base station's water inlet to see if there is any water. Additionally, check if the rubber plug is damaged or missing.

https://d3pkbgk01oouhl.cloudfront.net/upload_file/prod/Silicone-for-base-station-water-injection2.png

5. Update the firmware to version 7.0.143 or higher.
